evals.prompt: I have an idea: a WhatsApp-first appointment and payments app for small salons in India. Who are my competitors, what do people say about them, what would I be missing, and how do I stand out?
evals.expected_output: Idea-mode context, three tier files from parallel agents, a gap check against the stated idea, and a published intel page.
expectations: The brief restates the idea as product, buyer and problem, and marks the stage as idea
Three agents ran in parallel, one per tier, each writing its own tier_<tier>.json
Every row has a source_url, and vendor claims are marked unverified
Gap statuses quote the user's own description or say 'not mentioned'
The subtitle says status means 'in your plan', not shipped
The page was built by scripts/build_table.py and shows all 4 lenses and 3 tiers

evals.prompt: Here's our site: https://example-crm.com. Do a competitor analysis and tell me what we're missing versus the leaders.
evals.expected_output: Context read from the website's feature, pricing and docs pages, with gap evidence as URL plus section.
expectations: The features, pricing and docs pages of the site were read before the research started
Gap evidence cites a URL and section of our site
'Coming soon' claims are marked Partial, not Built
The final message lists assumptions and any blocked sources

evals.prompt: Run a competitor analysis for our product; the code is in the org's frontend and backend repos.
evals.expected_output: Code-grounded gap check with file:line evidence, and a callout for any claim the code contradicts.
expectations: Module or folder names were listed before grepping
Each gap has file:line or 'grep x = 0 hits' evidence

evals.prompt: Refresh the competitor table, only what changed in the last 90 days.
evals.expected_output: A new dated run via --from-latest, updated rows, a re-run gap check and a v(N+1) page with a change list.
expectations: scripts/new_run.sh --from-latest was used and no earlier run was overwritten
The output file name increments the version
The reply lists what changed since the last version
